threads.title: Cash discounts at Charlotte Pike
threads.purpose: S2: the managing owner's first thread, the evening the bookkeeper's check did not add up. The table is in the answer text; no stored result is relied on.

turns.user: Donna says the Charlotte Pike tills don't add up against the payments. Are cash orders there being discounted more than at our other shops? Show me by advisor, last twelve months.
turns.assistant:
Yes, and it is one advisor.

{{#by_advisor}}

Brent Lassiter took 10 % or more off {{=orders.discounted|site=west&advisor=F1&pay=cash&min=10|@now-12mo..@now|n:cash order/cash orders}}, {{=orders.discounted_share|site=west&advisor=F1&pay=cash&min=10|@now-12mo..@now|pct}} of the cash orders he closed. For every other advisor in the company it is {{=orders.discounted_share|site=all&advisor=!F1&pay=cash&min=10|@now-12mo..@now|pct}}. His run from 15 to 30 %, and the first is dated {{@leak_start|date}}.

Source: shop system, paid cash orders, discount measured on the bill before tax.
expect: orders.discounted for F1 is 30 to 35 (ledger s2.f1.discounted counts to the firing)
the others' share is ledger pay.background_discount_share within 1 point

turns.user: Who approved them?
turns.assistant: Nobody is recorded. An order has a field for who approved a discount, and it is empty on all {{=orders.discounted|site=west&advisor=F1&pay=cash&min=10|@now-12mo..@now|int}}. It is empty on everyone else's discounts too: no rule makes anyone fill it in, so the blank by itself proves little. What sets his apart is how many there are and how deep they go.

turns.user: Which customers got them? I want to call a few.
turns.assistant:
None of them can be called. All {{=orders.on_walkin|site=west&advisor=F1&pay=cash&min=10|@now-12mo..@now|int}} sit on the shop's "Walk-in customer" record, which has no name and no phone. A discount with nobody to ask about it is part of the same pattern.

Source: shop system, the customer on each order.

turns.user: Anything else unusual under his name?
turns.assistant:
Two things.

- Voids: {{=orders.voided|site=west&advisor=F1&after_payment=yes|@now-12mo..@now|n:order/orders}} voided after cash was taken, {{=orders.voided_money|site=west&advisor=F1&after_payment=yes|@now-12mo..@now|money0}} in totals. No other advisor in the company has more than {{=orders.voided_max_per_advisor|site=all&advisor=!F1&after_payment=yes|@now-12mo..@now|int}}.
- The till: short by $20 or more on {{=till.short_days|site=west&closed_by=F1&min=20|@now-12mo..@now|int}} of the {{=till.closes|site=west&closed_by=F1|@now-12mo..@now|int}} days he closed it, {{=till.short_money|site=west&closed_by=F1&min=20|@now-12mo..@now|money0}} in all.

None of this shows where the money went. It shows three patterns under one name.

Source: shop system: voided orders with their payments, daily till counts.
